purpose: Stop technically incomplete or visually confusing gameplay captures from reaching Kevin, the website, social channels or distribution partners.

moments.title: THE CREATURE HELPS
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Stage one large foreground obstacle with the astronaut and creature beside it, show the creature perform one unmistakable physical action, and let the changed route or rescued object dominate the frame without explanation boxes or competing settlement overlays.

moments.title: A CHOICE CHANGES SOMETHING
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Keep the short choice, then cut back to exactly the same clean camera position and transform a large recognisable area of terrain or structure so a child can spot the difference immediately without reading the recap.

moments.title: A STRANGE DISCOVERY
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Build one impossible alien event into a quiet playable space—such as liquid memory climbing, folded light opening or gravity changing direction—and frame both characters reacting to that single phenomenon with no settlement-map clutter.

moments.title: MOVEMENT FEELS ALIVE
moments.nextCaptureMustShow: Record a complete six-to-ten-second route through a richly layered scene with intentional phone framing, one jump or obstacle, visible environmental life and a rewarding change, while both characters remain readable and the desktop capture meets the full frame floor.

captureFailure.meaning: The capture run itself is not reliable enough to produce launch proof, and the complete phone plus partial desktop evidence also fails the human visual bar.

nextGate.request: Treat marketing capture as part of the game presentation: simplify the village camera, remove overlapping map-like effects, make consequences physically large, compose the entire phone canvas without a black gutter, and build one short traversal route with a visible beginning, event and payoff.
